# Porcelain Dental Crowns in Huntington Beach


At Oceanic Dental in Huntington Beach, we craft high-quality porcelain crowns that restore both the strength and beauty of your teeth. Whether you’ve experienced decay, a cracked tooth, or had a root canal, our team provides long-lasting, custom crowns using the latest digital scanning and ceramic technology.

What are Dental Crowns?


## What are Porcelain Crowns?


Porcelain crowns are tooth-shaped caps that are placed over damaged or decayed teeth to restore their shape, size, strength, and appearance. They are made from high-quality porcelain, which mimics the natural translucency of teeth, making them an ideal choice for a natural-looking restoration. Whether you need to protect a weakened tooth, cover a discolored tooth, or support a tooth with a large filling, porcelain crowns provide a versatile and effective solution.


## When Is a Crown Needed?


Dental crowns are needed when a tooth is weakened, damaged, or aesthetically compromised.

Strengthening Teeth: To cover and protect teeth that have been severely weakened by large cavities or extensive decay.

Post-Root Canal and Implants: To protect teeth after root canals and to attach to dental implants for replacing missing teeth.

Aesthetic and Functional Improvements: Enhance the color, shape, and alignment of teeth, and correct bite issues.

Restore Your Smile with Ease


## Getting Porcelain Crowns in Huntington Beach Today is a Straightforward and Stress-Free Experience


At Oceanic Dental, getting a porcelain crown is a simple and stress-free experience. Our Huntington Beach dental experts ensure that every step is tailored to your specific needs, providing you with a high-quality crown that's durable and natural-looking, restoring your smile to its best.


### Free Consultation & Personalized Planning


Start with a complimentary consultation where you'll meet our friendly doctors, have photos taken, and discuss your dental goals. We’ll evaluate your teeth, explore treatment options, and answer all your questions. With detailed X-rays, 3D oral scans, and precise planning, we ensure your crown will be a perfect fit.


### Preparation and Custom Crafting


We carefully prepare your tooth by removing any decay and shaping it for the crown. An impression is then taken to create your custom crown. You'll receive a temporary crown while the permanent one is crafted.


### Placement and Final Adjustments


Once your permanent crown is ready, we will schedule an appointment for its placement. Our dentists will ensure a precise fit, making any necessary adjustments to ensure your comfort and bite alignment. This process ensures you receive a high-quality porcelain crown with minimal hassle, restoring your smile to its best.


## Why Huntington Beach Patients Choose Us



### Not All Crowns Are Created Equal


At Oceanic Dental, we uphold a high standard for dental crowns. We believe a dental crown should do more than restore a tooth—it should blend seamlessly into your smile, feel completely natural, and stand the test of time. That’s why our doctors and experienced technicians approach every crown with meticulous care and craftsmanship.

Each crown is custom-designed to match the exact shade, shape, and translucency of your natural teeth, ensuring a flawless, lifelike result.

With ultra-precise margins and high-quality materials, we create crowns that not only look beautiful but also function effortlessly.

Every detail, from the way light reflects off the surface to the perfect fit against your gumline, is carefully considered.

We are confident that at Oceanic Dental, we don’t just make crowns—we create seamless extensions of your natural teeth, restoring confidence and comfort with every smile.


## FAQs


Find answers to commonly asked questions by Huntington Beach patients about dental crowns.

How long do porcelain crowns last?

Porcelain crowns typically last between 10 to 15 years with proper care. Good oral hygiene, regular checkups, and avoiding habits like teeth grinding can help extend their lifespan.

Do porcelain crowns look natural?

Yes. Porcelain crowns are designed to match the color, shape, and translucency of natural teeth. They blend in seamlessly and are often indistinguishable from your real teeth.

When do I need a crown instead of a filling?

A crown is typically recommended when a tooth is too damaged or weakened to support a filling. This includes cases with large cavities, cracks, after a root canal, or for cosmetic reshaping.

Is getting a crown painful?

The procedure is usually not painful. We use local anesthesia to keep you comfortable. You may experience slight sensitivity or soreness afterward, which typically resolves quickly.

How many visits does a porcelain crown take?

Most porcelain crowns require two visits: one to prepare the tooth and take a digital scan, and another to fit and place the final crown. In some cases, a temporary crown is used in between.
